note: lib arm (D30 fixes): per-model data the code reads after the fill call. answerKeys: build keys (the model's own builds(P).steps[].key) that show the answer; a question slide draws the last build before the first of them, or no model. cannot: what the model cannot draw, with the intent patterns (case-insensitive regex) that ask for it. Not prompt text. drops: validate() warnings (case-insensitive regex on the reason) that mean the drawing leaves out something the params asked for; they count as refusals, so the repair call sees them (libfix2).

cannot.what: unequal parts (fractions draws equal parts only)
two different shapes in one picture (fractions draws every fraction in one representation)
marking some of the groups as taken (it draws N ÷ G only)
places outside its regions (UK, south, North Sea, Europe, Mediterranean, world outline)
